mode.description: Changes the entire mode and resets prior per-feature overrides; include any overrides to keep in this request.

activation_timeout.description: Physical confirmation window, 10 seconds to 1 day (RouterOS duration, e.g. 5m or 00:05:00).

flagged.description: Set false only after a security audit of the router configuration.

confirm_mode_resets_overrides.description: Required with mode: existing per-feature overrides will be reset unless included in this request.

confirm_flagged_audit_complete.description: Required to clear flagged after auditing configuration, passwords, and RouterOS version.

physical_confirmation_available.description: Operator is physically present and has authorized the device-mode change.
